Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to learn that your grill is not getting above 450 degrees. We want to make sure that everything is working correctly for you. Here are some things to check:

1.) Please make sure you consider "High" on your control knobs to be the first spot to your left (the 9:00 position). The further you go to the right the lower the temperature will be and all the way to the right is low.

2.) Please make sure you're always cooking with the lid down except when flipping the food halfway. The second you open the lid the heat escapes, and you'll need to close it to let the temperature recover.

If troubleshooting doesn't resolve the issue, don't worry. Our Support team is sending you a follow-up email now to offer our assistance. We look forward to helping you soon!

Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to learn that your experience has not matched your expectations. We want all of our Weber grill owners to love grilling with us!

We understand that you are disappointed with the corrosion on your grill. While it is normal for some rust to occur, we expect our products to be long-lasting, and we stand by them with a generous warranty. 

Maintenance to treat corrosion when and where it occurs is crucial for keeping your grill from being damaged over time. We recommend cleaning and treating exterior rust with Weber Stainless Steel Polish. 

Your satisfaction is very important to us. Our Support team is sending you a follow-up email now. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Photos.Caption: Rust and worn ceramic under 2 years use

Results.ReviewText: Overall, my experience of finally owning a Weber grill is much lower than my expectations.  Especially for a premium price, I’m surprised how quickly this model is rusting and the porcelain wearing off.  At this point, I wish we had either not bought a Weber or had spent a couple hundred more to get into your stainless steel line of grills and maybe I would have a better opinion and/or experience with Weber.   I give the grill a 2 of 5 but I give the CSR that has been helping me rebuild the our grill 5 of 5.   However, the parts we’ve been given are the same low quality of the original parts so I expect to be filing more claims with you every couple of years as they rust/etc.    I truly wish I could say I love my Weber grill and talk about it positively at our family and neighborhood gatherings, but I can’t.  I expect I’ll get frustrated before rebuilding it again, and cut my losses.   Appreciate your ear and first set of replacement parts; however, please consider making improvements to avoid others having this same experience.
Results.Title: After Waiting 20 Years Unfortunately Disappointed

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
